fill=\"currentColor\" fill-rule=\"nonzero\" transform=\"matrix(1 0 0 1 1 1)\"/>"}};

window.wfIcon=function(name,size){var d=window.WF_ICONS[name];if(!d)return '';return '<svg class="wf-ic" width="'+(size||24)+'" height="'+(size||24)+'" viewBox="'+d.viewBox+'" fill="currentColor" fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">'+d.body+'</svg>';};
window.wfRenderIcons=function(root){(root||document).querySelectorAll('[data-icon]').forEach(function(el){if(el.dataset.done)return;el.innerHTML=window.wfIcon(el.getAttribute('data-icon'),el.getAttribute('data-size')||24);el.dataset.done='1';});};
/* Per-article icons by keyword. Reads each article row's title and picks a
   fitting icon; matched in priority order (specific first), book as fallback.
   Runs in JS so a miss just leaves the book icon — it can never break the page.
   Consistent across the whole help center: same title keyword => same icon. */
window.WF_ARTICLE_ICON_RULES=[
  [/\b(shortcut|hotkey|keyboard|key ?binding)/i,'NiKeyboard'],
  [/\b(permission|accessibility|grant)/i,'NiShieldCheck'],
  [/\b(invoice|billing|payment|subscription|pricing|refund|charge|receipt|plan)/i,'NiCard'],
  [/\b(sso|scim|saml|okta|provision|identity|directory)/i,'NiUserCircle'],
  [/\b(login|log in|sign ?in|password|credential)/i,'NiLock'],
  [/\b(uninstall)/i,'NiWrench'],
  [/\b(install|download|installer|get flow running)/i,'NiBoxArrowInDown'],
  [/\b(language|languages|multilingual|accent)/i,'NiGlobe'],
  [/\b(dictat|speak|voice|record|transcri|audio|microphone|mic)/i,'NiMicrophone2'],
  [/\b(command mode|command|transform|auto cleanup|snippet)/i,'NiBolt'],
  [/\b(privacy|security|encrypt|soc ?2|hipaa|gdpr|trust)/i,'NiLock'],
  [/\b(enterprise|team|admin|organization|seat|cost center)/i,'NiUserCircle'],
  [/\b(reset|restart|relaunch|quit|troubleshoot|fix|not working|won.?t|can.?t|crash|error|problem|issue)/i,'NiWrench'],
  [/\b(device|system requirement|supported|compatib|hardware)/i,'NiSliders'],
  [/\b(setting|configure|preference|customize)/i,'NiSliders'],
  [/\b(dark mode|theme|appearance)/i,'NiMoon'],
  [/\b(style|styles|formatting)/i,'NiPencil'],
  [/\b(update|version|release|changelog)/i,'NiClockHistory'],
  [/\b(known issue|status|outage|degrad)/i,'NiInfoCircle'],
  [/\b(welcome|what is flow|getting started|intro|overview|first dictation|your first)/i,'NiStar'],
  [/\b(mac|macos|apple|ios|iphone|ipad)/i,'NiApple'],
  [/\b(windows|pc)/i,'NiWindows'],
  [/\b(android)/i,'NiAndroid']
];
window.wfArticleIcon=function(title){
  var t=(title||'').toString();
  for(var i=0;i<window.WF_ARTICLE_ICON_RULES.length;i++){
    if(window.WF_ARTICLE_ICON_RULES[i][0].test(t))return window.WF_ARTICLE_ICON_RULES[i][1];
  }
  return 'NiBookOpen';
};
window.wfArticleIcons=function(root){
  (root||document).querySelectorAll('[data-article-icon]').forEach(function(holder){
    if(holder.dataset.aidone)return;
    var row=holder.closest('.arow');
    var titleEl=row&&row.querySelector('.at');
    var title=titleEl?titleEl.textContent:'';
    var icon=window.wfArticleIcon(title);
    var svg=window.wfIcon(icon,19);
    if(svg){holder.innerHTML=svg;}
    holder.dataset.aidone='1';
  });
};
/* Swap Pylon's folder glyph in each search result for the matching COLLECTION
   icon, keyed off the row's breadcrumb collection name (the real data present in
   the markup). Keeps search icons consistent with the sidebar/hero collection
   icons. Per-article icons aren't possible here (no per-row article hook). */
window.WF_COLL_ICON={
  'Getting Started':'NiRocket',
  'Using Wispr Flow':'NiCompass',
  'Transcription Accuracy & Voice Quality':'NiVolumeHigh',
  'Billing & Plans':'NiCard',
  'Troubleshooting':'NiWrench',
  'Privacy, Security & Data':'NiShieldCheck',
  'Known Issues':'NiInfoCircle'
};
window.wfSearchIcons=function(root){
  (root||document).querySelectorAll('.kb-search-result-item').forEach(function(item){
    if(item.dataset.wficon)return;
    var crumbs=item.querySelector('.kb-search-result-breadcrumbs');
    if(!crumbs)return;
    /* the collection is the LAST breadcrumb link (e.g. "Getting Started");
       external results (wisprflow.ai) have a favicon, leave those as-is */
    if(crumbs.querySelector('.kb-search-result-breadcrumb-favicon')){item.dataset.wficon='1';return;}
    var links=crumbs.querySelectorAll('.kb-search-result-breadcrumb-link');
    var name=links.length?links[links.length-1].textContent.trim():'';
    var icon=window.WF_COLL_ICON[name]||'NiBookOpen';
    /* the folder svg is the first direct child (a bare <svg> or a .contents wrapper) */
    var holder=crumbs.querySelector(':scope > svg, :scope > .contents');
    if(holder){
      var svg=window.wfIcon(icon,20);
      if(holder.tagName.toLowerCase()==='svg'){
        /* bare svg: replace the element itself so we don't nest svg-in-svg */
        var tmp=document.createElement('div');tmp.innerHTML=svg;
        var newSvg=tmp.firstChild;
        holder.parentNode.replaceChild(newSvg,holder);
      }else{
        /* .contents wrapper: swap its inner svg */
        holder.innerHTML=svg;
      }
    }
    item.dataset.wficon='1';
  });
};
/* Set the native search input's placeholder to match the design copy. */
window.wfSearchPlaceholder=function(){
  var input=document.querySelector('#kb-search input');
  if(input && input.placeholder!=='Ask anything, like \u201chow do I fix my hotkey?\u201d'){
    input.placeholder='Ask anything, like \u201chow do I fix my hotkey?\u201d';
  }
};
/* Pylon shows the AI answer's source list only on HOVER of the "N" chip (it's
   injected on hover, not present in the DOM). Best-effort: fire a hover on the
   chip so Pylon builds the list, then block the leave event so it stays open. */
window.wfPinSources=function(){
  document.querySelectorAll('.kb-sources-chip-wrapper').forEach(function(w){
    if(w.dataset.wfpin)return;
    w.dataset.wfpin='1';
    ['mouseleave','pointerleave','mouseout'].forEach(function(ev){
      w.addEventListener(ev,function(e){e.stopImmediatePropagation();},true);
    });
    ['pointerenter','mouseenter','mouseover'].forEach(function(ev){
      try{w.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent(ev,{bubbles:true,cancelable:true,view:window}));}catch(e){}
    });
  });
};
window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',function(){window.wfRenderIcons();window.wfArticleIcons();window.wfSearchIcons();window.wfSearchPlaceholder();window.wfPinSources();});
window.addEventListener('load',function(){window.wfRenderIcons();window.wfArticleIcons();window.wfSearchIcons();window.wfSearchPlaceholder();window.wfPinSources();});
setTimeout(function(){window.wfRenderIcons();window.wfArticleIcons();window.wfSearchIcons();window.wfSearchPlaceholder();window.wfPinSources();},600);
setTimeout(function(){window.wfRenderIcons();window.wfArticleIcons();window.wfSearchIcons();window.wfSearchPlaceholder();window.wfPinSources();},1500);
if(window.MutationObserver){new MutationObserver(function(){window.wfRenderIcons();window.wfArticleIcons();window.wfSearchIcons();window.wfSearchPlaceholder();window.wfPinSources();}).observe(document.documentElement,{childList:true,subtree:true});}
</script>
<script>
/* Wispr Flow Help Center, shared behavior */
(function () {
  // ---- official Wispr Flow logo (hotlinked from the help center CDN) ----
  var LOGO_ONLIGHT = "https://assets.usepylon.com/968d194e-70a2-41bb-8b23-55910e24d9a4%2F1775584889804-logo-full-dark.png?Expires=253370764800&Signature=UWA7qYP8AAQXsGCOiPtX4dkk81ey6y5XM0zNPWjszxJ54Xh0NK57iMuxdh0TMXT8lVidmYuV1HfaJ2cu7oms7YXg2TUZMaLcNH2j5zS94~L7n1AgGxxqvupik9eIB1Rhy6qKfq8YsZmGSH4Um~PfvT0POkYiXqCaOw4DgWC8um9Us-lS2HV79EXr047B~mrQsOodVhvfYzj5JNVfmDw3rJGazpszmazSQb6WpZfPVwiV4rBWLl~edpIq4N~6oiUHCTqOucT-u61UDb7o8Y5XGnSrUEJS5N2KT9hrKmE8dPP3vlho5jmdT8bzvvvb341Y7gxiL3SOE-GzBKr16H1IQw__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46";
  var LOGO_ONDARK = "https://assets.usepylon.com/968d194e-70a2-41bb-8b23-55910e24d9a4%2F1775584884398-logo-full-light.png?Expires=253370764800&Signature=oMFz~irLDdv7~o0uDY40I5-yv1EH-ZbJ4nbqSEPFEo9afO3pIP9dDZZkTbfFaaZf480WQ26LmOOpWuUTpvb-I77y0gqaH6W5mxd3DxC6CqjgoyTtf~r7S-e4VT3pDntw2Q17Po4PgiwF7t-UQEnDfd3koNNjmKNjJ1s7FUgh8hTfN5Yj-AGKEH0pXIe3SmNOfDMD7MkVOJynarjmD3BEu26AkwRJXWdAc6SevEOijeyUbBy-4XlNdeCC4EyLF4aU2hA7xN3aD6TU99cxXSFRtycS8Fr5pDCRm9rYJyZJfjiVREP6E7ZzqF919q5wJWuPVTd2~WsgWHcEZtS9NZIwrA__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46";
  window.wfBrand = function(){
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-brand]').forEach(function(el){
      var tag = el.getAttribute('data-brand-tag');
      el.innerHTML =
        '<img class="brand-logo brand-logo--onlight" src="'+LOGO_ONLIGHT+'" alt="Wispr Flow" width="1018" height="168">'+
        '<img class="brand-logo brand-logo--ondark" src="'+LOGO_ONDARK+'" alt="Wispr Flow" width="1018" height="168">'+
        (tag==='none' ? '' : '<span class="brand-tag">'+(tag||'Help Center')+'</span>');
    });
  };

  // ---- theme ----
  // Pylon renders the navbar, layout and footer from separate files, so the
  // theme attribute is applied to EVERY .wf-help container (plus <html>) so
  // they all switch together.
  var root = document.documentElement;
  function applyTheme(t){
    root.setAttribute('data-theme', t);
    document.querySelectorAll('.wf-help').forEach(function(el){ el.setAttribute('data-theme', t); });
  }
  var saved = localStorage.getItem('wf-theme') || 'light';
  applyTheme(saved);
  window.wfToggleTheme = function () {
    var next = root.getAttribute('data-theme') === 'dark' ? 'light' : 'dark';
    applyTheme(next);
    localStorage.setItem('wf-theme', next);
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-theme-ic]').forEach(syncThemeIcon);
  };
  function syncThemeIcon(el){
    var dark = root.getAttribute('data-theme') === 'dark';
    el.innerHTML = window.wfIcon ? window.wfIcon(dark ? 'NiBrightness' : 'NiMoon', 18) : '';
    var btn = el.closest('button');
    if(btn){ var label = dark ? 'Switch to light mode' : 'Switch to dark mode'; btn.setAttribute('title', label); btn.setAttribute('aria-label', label); }
  }
  window.wfSyncTheme = function(){ document.querySelectorAll('[data-theme-ic]').forEach(syncThemeIcon); };

  // ---- reveal (kept fully visible; subtle one-time fade only where supported) ----
  window.wfReveal = function(){ document.documentElement.classList.add('js'); };

  // ---- search (AI-powered natural language, with instant keyword fallback) ----
  function escapeHtml(s){ return String(s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, function(c){ return ({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'})[c]; }); }
  function noDash(s){ return String(s).replace(/\s*[\u2014\u2013]\s*/g, ', '); }
  function hl(text,q){
    var i = text.toLowerCase().indexOf(q.toLowerCase());
    if(q.length<2 || i<0) return escapeHtml(text);
    return escapeHtml(text.slice(0,i))+'<mark>'+escapeHtml(text.slice(i,i+q.length))+'</mark>'+escapeHtml(text.slice(i+q.length));
  }

  window.wfInitSearch = function (input, resultsEl) {
    if (!input || !window.WF) return;
    var A = window.WF.ARTICLES;
    var seq = 0;

    function localHits(q){
      q = q.trim().toLowerCase();
      return A.map(function(a){
        var col = window.WF.collection(a.c);
        var hay = (a.t+' '+a.b+' '+a.tag+' '+(col?col.title:'')).toLowerCase();
        var score = 0;
        q.split(/\s+/).forEach(function(w){ if(w && hay.indexOf(w)>=0) score += 1; });
        if (a.t.toLowerCase().indexOf(q)>=0) score += 5;
        if (a.t.toLowerCase().indexOf(q)===0) score += 4;
        return { a:a, col:col, score:score };
      }).filter(function(h){return h.score>0;}).sort(function(x,y){return y.score-x.score;}).slice(0,6);
    }

    function row(h, q){
      return '<a class="ritem" href="article.html?a='+h.a.id+'">'+
        '<span class="ric">'+window.wfIcon(h.a.icon,17)+'</span>'+
        '<span class="rcol"><span class="rti">'+hl(h.a.t, q||'')+'</span><span class="rmeta">'+(h.col?h.col.title:'')+' · '+h.a.read+'</span></span>'+
        '<span class="rarrow">'+window.wfIcon('NiChevronRight',16)+'</span>'+
      '</a>';
    }

    function render(hits, q, opts){
      opts = opts || {};
      if (!hits.length && !opts.thinking){
        resultsEl.innerHTML = '<div class="rempty">No articles match that yet. Try different words or <a class="ilink" href="https://wisprflow.ai/support" target="_blank" rel="noopener">contact support</a>.</div>';
        resultsEl.classList.add('open'); return;
      }
      var head;
      if (opts.ai){
        head = '<div class="rhead rhead-ai">'+window.wfIcon('NiBolt',14)+'<span>AI results</span></div>';
      } else if (opts.thinking){
        head = '<div class="rhead rhead-ai"><span class="rspin"></span><span>Searching with AI…</span></div>';
      } else {
        head = '<div class="rhead">'+hits.length+' result'+(hits.length>1?'s':'')+'</div>';
      }
      var answer = '';
      if (opts.answer){
        answer = '<div class="rai">'+window.wfIcon('NiBolt',16)+'<span>'+escapeHtml(noDash(opts.answer))+'</span></div>';
      }
      resultsEl.innerHTML = head + answer + hits.map(function(h){return row(h,q);}).join('');
      resultsEl.classList.add('open');
    }

    function localRender(q){ render(localHits(q), q, {}); }

    async function aiRender(q){
      var my = ++seq;
      var base = localHits(q);
      render(base, q, { thinking:true });            // instant local list + spinner
      if (!(window.claude && window.claude.complete)){ render(base, q, {}); return; }
      try {
        var catalog = A.map(function(a){ return a.id+': '+a.t+' | '+a.b; }).join('\n');
        var prompt = 'You are the search assistant for the Wispr Flow help center. Wispr Flow is a voice dictation app for Mac, Windows, iPhone and Android that types what you say in any app.\n'+
          'From the article list below, choose the articles most relevant to the user question and write one short, helpful sentence guiding them to the best answer.\n\n'+
          'ARTICLES:\n'+catalog+'\n\n'+
          'USER QUESTION: "'+q+'"\n\n'+
          'Respond with ONLY raw JSON, no code fences: {"answer":"one short sentence, plain text, no dashes","ids":["id1","id2"]}. Put up to 5 ids, best first. If nothing is relevant use {"answer":"","ids":[]}.';
        var raw = await window.claude.complete(prompt);
        if (my !== seq) return; // a newer query superseded this one
        var m = raw && raw.match(/\{[\s\S]*\}/);
        if (!m) { render(base, q, {}); return; }
        var data = JSON.parse(m[0]);
        var hits = (data.ids||[]).map(function(id){ var a = window.WF.byId(id); return a ? { a:a, col:window.WF.collection(a.c) } : null; }).filter(Boolean);
        if (hits.length) render(hits, q, { ai:true, answer:data.answer });
        else render(base, q, {});
      } catch (e) {
        if (my === seq) render(base, q, {});
      }
    }

    var t;
    input.addEventListener('input', function(){
      var q = input.value.trim();
      clearTimeout(t);
      if (q.length < 2){ resultsEl.classList.remove('open'); resultsEl.innerHTML=''; return; }
      localRender(q);
      t = setTimeout(function(){ aiRender(q); }, 420);
    });
    input.addEventListener('focus', function(){ if(input.value.trim().length>=2) localRender(input.value.trim()); });
    document.addEventListener('click', function(e){ if(!resultsEl.contains(e.target) && e.target!==input) resultsEl.classList.remove('open'); });
    input.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){
      if(e.key==='Enter'){
        var first=resultsEl.querySelector('a.ritem');
        if(first){ window.location.href=first.getAttribute('href'); return; }
        clearTimeout(t); aiRender(input.value.trim());
      }
      if(e.key==='Escape'){ resultsEl.classList.remove('open'); input.blur(); }
    });
    document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){
      if((e.metaKey||e.ctrlKey) && e.key.toLowerCase()==='k'){ e.preventDefault(); input.focus(); input.select(); }
    });
  };

  // ---- article page: scroll-spy on the server-rendered TOC + feedback ----
  window.wfInitArticle = function(){
    var body = document.getElementById('artBody');
    var toc  = document.getElementById('toc');
    if (toc && body){
      var links = [].slice.call(toc.querySelectorAll('a'));
      links.forEach(function(l){
        l.addEventListener('click', function(e){
          var id = l.getAttribute('href').slice(1);
          var el = document.getElementById(id);
          if (el){ e.preventDefault(); window.scrollTo({ top: el.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.scrollY - 80, behavior:'smooth' }); }
        });
      });
      var heads = links.map(function(l){ return document.getElementById(l.getAttribute('href').slice(1)); }).filter(Boolean);
      if (heads.length){
        var spy = function(){
          var y = window.scrollY + 100, cur = 0;
          heads.forEach(function(h,i){ if (h.offsetTop <= y) cur = i; });
          links.forEach(function(l,i){ l.classList.toggle('active', i === cur); });
        };
        window.addEventListener('scroll', spy, { passive:true });
        spy();
      }
    }
    var hy = document.getElementById('hYes'), hn = document.getElementById('hNo'), ht = document.getElementById('hThanks');
    function thank(b){ if(hy)hy.classList.remove('on'); if(hn)hn.classList.remove('on'); b.classList.add('on'); if(ht)ht.style.display='inline'; }
    if (hy) hy.addEventListener('click', function(){ thank(hy); });
    if (hn) hn.addEventListener('click', function(){ thank(hn); });
  };

  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function(){
    if (window.wfBrand) window.wfBrand();
    applyTheme(localStorage.getItem('wf-theme') || 'light');
    window.wfSyncTheme();
    window.wfReveal();
    window.wfInitArticle();
  });
})();

</script>
</head>
<body>

}

            <div class="kb-article-header">
              <h1 class="kb-article-title">Manage data sharing, cloud storage and local history</h1>
              
              <div class="kb-article-meta">
                Last updated 13 days ago<span id="kb-article-edit"></span>
              </div>
              
            </div>
            <div class="kb-article-body">
              <div class="kb-article-body-placeholder"><div data-color="blue" data-icon="lightBulb" data-type="callout"><p style="padding-left: 0px!important;"><strong>Available on:</strong> Mac, Windows, iOS and Android. Agreement actions differ by platform.</p></div><p style="padding-left: 0px!important;">Flow keeps model improvement and dictation cloud storage separate: changing one does not change the other. Check each control independently.</p><div data-type="horizontalRule"><hr/></div><h2 style="padding-left: 0px!important;" id="">Choose your data settings</h2><ol><li><p style="padding-left: 0px!important;"><strong>Open</strong> Flow from the menu bar or system tray on desktop.</p></li><li><p style="padding-left: 0px!important;"><strong>Go</strong> to <strong>Settings → Data and Privacy</strong> in the Account section.</p></li></ol><div class="tableWrapper"><table><tbody><tr><td data-colspan="1" data-rowspan="1"><p style="padding-left: 0px!important;">Control</p></td><td data-colspan="1" data-rowspan="1"><p style="padding-left: 0px!important;">What it changes</p></td></tr><tr><td data-colspan="1" data-rowspan="1"><p style="padding-left: 0px!important;"><strong>Improve the model for everyone</strong></p></td><td data-colspan="1" data-rowspan="1"><p style="padding-left: 0px!important;">Allows or blocks use of your Notetaker and dictation content to improve Wispr&#39;s models.</p></td></tr><tr><td data-colspan="1" data-rowspan="1"><p style="padding-left: 0px!important;"><strong>Dictation cloud storage</strong></p></td><td data-colspan="1" data-rowspan="1"><p style="padding-left: 0px!important;">Stores dictation transcripts, audio and history on Wispr&#39;s servers for cross-device access.</p></td></tr></tbody></table></div><p style="padding-left: 0px!important;">Both switches default to on unless restricted and save immediately in either direction, without confirmation; <strong>Dictation cloud storage</strong> appears when available for your account.</p><div data-color="yellow" data-icon="warning" data-type="callout"><p style="padding-left: 0px!important;"><strong>Important:</strong> For confidential or privileged content, turn <strong>Improve the model for everyone</strong> off before recording. Turning it off does not stop cloud processing. For model improvement and evaluation, audio, transcripts, edits and other personal content are withheld; Flow still uploads dictation details such as word count, duration, app, URL, timestamp, app version, microphone, detected language and edit statistics. A dictation you choose to report is retained by Wispr and can be used to train and evaluate its models.</p></div><p style="padding-left: 0px!important;">Wispr does not sell your data; aggregate usage statistics, such as words dictated, do not include dictation contents. <strong>Learn more</strong> beside either switch and <strong>Read about our Data Controls</strong> open <a href="https://wisprflow.ai/data-usage">how Wispr uses data</a>.</p><p style="padding-left: 0px!important;"><strong>Dictation cloud storage</strong> does not control meeting storage: Notetaker transcripts and summaries are stored in Wispr&#39;s cloud, with no setting to opt out. On desktop, turning cloud storage off does not stop recording once Flow confirms your organization and agreement details, but blocks new recordings while it is still confirming them or cannot confirm your preferences.</p><div data-type="horizontalRule"><hr/></div><h2 style="padding-left: 0px!important;" id="">When a setting is locked</h2><p style="padding-left: 0px!important;">On desktop, check a disabled control&#39;s tooltip for its cause. You cannot override the restriction in the app; other unlocked changes still save.</p><p style="padding-left: 0px!important;">A signed HIPAA Business Associate Agreement (BAA) locks sharing off. A personal or organization BAA locks <strong>Dictation cloud storage</strong> off and blocks Notetaker recording, even if another organization setting permits sharing. Organization sharing and cloud-storage policies are independent: sharing can be locked off while cloud storage remains individually controlled. On Enterprise, sharing stays off, so Wispr does not use these organizations&#39; dictation content to improve its models.</p><p style="padding-left: 0px!important;">Your organization can also manage audio during dictation. When an admin enables <strong>Always mute audio while dictating</strong>, <strong>Mute all audio while dictating</strong> (<strong>Settings → System</strong>) is turned on and locked, and <strong>Pause music</strong> (<strong>Settings → Experimental</strong>) is turned off and locked. If the admin later turns the policy off, both controls unlock and your mute setting stays on until you change it.</p><div data-type="accordion_list"><div data-type="accordion"><div data-type="accordion_summary"><p style="padding-left: 0px!important;"><strong>Lock messages</strong></p></div><div data-type="accordion_details"><p style="padding-left: 0px!important;">The tooltip identifies the restriction:</p><ul><li><p style="padding-left: 0px!important;"><strong>Sharing:</strong> “Your HIPAA agreement does not allow data to be used for model training.” or “Your organization does not allow data to be used for model training.”</p></li><li><p style="padding-left: 0px!important;"><strong>Cloud storage under a BAA:</strong> “Dictation Cloud Storage is locked off because HIPAA BAA is signed.”</p></li><li><p style="padding-left: 0px!important;"><strong>Organization-managed cloud storage or dictation audio:</strong> “This setting is managed by your organization.”</p></li></ul></div></div><div data-type="accordion"><div data-type="accordion_summary"><p style="padding-left: 0px!important;"><strong>Organization controls and permissions</strong></p></div><div data-type="accordion_details"><p style="padding-left: 0px!important;">Authorized admins manage policies in the <a href="https://admin.wisprflow.ai/app/settings/organization">Admin Portal&#39;s Organization settings</a>; controls depend on plan and permissions. Enterprise model training is <strong>Off for everyone</strong>, with no enable switch; Teams and Pro show <strong>Managed individually</strong>, so each member decides, and enforcing off for everyone requires upgrading to Enterprise.</p><p style="padding-left: 0px!important;"><strong>Always mute audio while dictating</strong> is off by default in the same Organization settings. Only admins can change it; members see it disabled with “Only admins can modify this”.</p><p style="padding-left: 0px!important;">If the portal instead shows <strong>Enforce zero data retention</strong>, only Enterprise admins can change it, unless Wispr has locked it or a signed BAA prevents disabling it. A Wispr lock directs you to contact support.</p><p style="padding-left: 0px!important;">On desktop Notetaker or cloud-storage access prompts, <strong>Request access</strong> shows <strong>Access requested</strong> but neither messages your admin nor grants access. Contact your admin directly, or open <strong>Contact team admins</strong> in Team settings, enter your message and select <strong>Send message</strong>.</p></div></div></div><div data-type="horizontalRule"><hr/></div><h2 style="padding-left: 0px!important;" id="">Signing or changing a BAA</h2><div data-color="yellow" data-icon="warning" data-type="callout"><p style="padding-left: 0px!important;"><strong>Important:</strong> Revoking changes agreement coverage; it does not turn sharing or dictation cloud storage back on. Review HIPAA guidance for account requirements and provider obligations before changing an agreement.</p></div><div data-type="accordion_list"><div data-type="accordion"><div data-type="accordion_summary"><p style="padding-left: 0px!important;"><strong>Individual agreement</strong></p></div><div data-type="accordion_details"><p style="padding-left: 0px!important;">Open the HIPAA BAA row in <strong>Settings → Data and Privacy</strong> on Mac or Windows, or <strong>Settings → Data &amp; Privacy</strong> on iOS.</p><ol><li><p style="padding-left: 0px!important;"><strong>Select</strong> <strong>View and accept</strong> under <strong>Enable HIPAA</strong> on desktop.</p></li><li><p style="padding-left: 0px!important;"><strong>Read</strong> the agreement.</p></li><li><p style="padding-left: 0px!important;"><strong>Enter</strong> your legal name.</p></li><li><p style="padding-left: 0px!important;"><strong>Select</strong> <strong>I agree</strong>; on desktop, the button is available after entering a name.</p></li></ol><p style="padding-left: 0px!important;">If signing fails, the sheet stays open for retry; desktop shows “Error signing HIPAA BAA”.</p><p style="padding-left: 0px!important;">On desktop, <strong>HIPAA enabled</strong> offers <strong>Revoke BAA</strong> and, when a signer is recorded, <strong>Download signed BAA</strong>, which saves <strong>HIPAA-BAA-signed.pdf</strong>; failure shows “Couldn&#39;t download the signed agreement”. A single HIPAA button instead offers <strong>View and accept</strong> before signing or <strong>Revoke</strong> afterward. A cloud-storage prompt outside Settings also offers <strong>View signed BAA</strong> and <strong>Revoke BAA</strong> for individual agreements.</p><p style="padding-left: 0px!important;">Android has no signing or revocation flow. iOS can display a signed agreement but has no revoke action: revoke an individual BAA signed on iOS from desktop.</p></div></div><div data-type="accordion"><div data-type="accordion_summary"><p style="padding-left: 0px!important;"><strong>Organization agreement</strong></p></div><div data-type="accordion_details"><p style="padding-left: 0px!important;">For business and enterprise members, the desktop row is <strong>Org-wide HIPAA</strong>. Admins use <strong>Admin Portal</strong> to sign or manage the agreement in Organization settings; signed agreements also offer <strong>View signed BAA</strong>. Non-admin members get only <strong>Open admin portal</strong>, with no in-app signing or revocation. Organization-BAA cloud-storage prompts also direct admins to <strong>Admin Portal</strong>.</p></div></div></div><div data-type="horizontalRule"><hr/></div><h2 style="padding-left: 0px!important;" id="">Check that changes have applied</h2><p style="padding-left: 0px!important;">Sharing and cloud-storage choices follow your account across devices, and opening desktop Settings refreshes them. For active business and enterprise subscriptions, opening Data and Privacy or returning focus to its window refreshes organization policy without restarting Flow. Check the displayed state after a policy change rather than assuming an earlier choice returns.</p><p style="padding-left: 0px!important;">On desktop, organization restrictions remain in effect during connection errors; Flow removes the saved organization policy only after confirming you no longer belong to an organization. Organization policy changes still apply on launch or sign-in. Switching accounts never deletes the history of the account you sign in to under the previous account&#39;s policy.</p><p style="padding-left: 0px!important;">Signing out resets the cloud-storage preference to on and clears the previous organization for the next sign-in; review both settings afterward. A signed BAA remains in effect and keeps cloud storage locked off. Signing in again does not reset your other preferences, and on desktop a required sign-in after session expiry does not reset cloud storage. Both sign-out and a required sign-in clear the device&#39;s recorded signature details, not the BAA itself.</p><p style="padding-left: 0px!important;">If Flow cannot confirm a sharing preference, agreement or organization policy, it does not share dictation audio; your device&#39;s opt-out holds.</p><div data-type="horizontalRule"><hr/></div><h2 style="padding-left: 0px!important;" id="">Still stuck?</h2><ul><li><p style="padding-left: 0px!important;">A setting is locked with no explanation, or your change does not save: contact support with your platform, plan, device, the control&#39;s exact message and what you tried.</p></li><li><p style="padding-left: 0px!important;">For processing, security or contractual details, see <a href="https://wisprflow.ai/data-controls">Data Controls</a> and the <a href="https://trust.wispr.ai/">Wispr Trust Center</a>.</p></li></ul></div>
              <div class="kb-article-body-skeleton">
                <div class="kb-article-skeleton-line kb-article-skeleton-line--lg"></div>

              </div>

            <div class="wf-help">
              <div class="cta wf-need-hand">
                <div class="cta-glow g1"></div>
                <div class="cta-glow g2"></div>
                <div class="cta-txt">
                  <h2>Need a hand?</h2>
                  <p>Reach the Flow team and we&rsquo;ll help you get unblocked.</p>
                </div>

Check the displayed state after a policy change rather than assuming an earlier choice returns.\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp style=\"padding-left: 0px!important;\"\u003eOn desktop, organization restrictions remain in effect during connection errors; Flow removes the saved organization policy only after confirming you no longer belong to an organization.
